    -   If $x(2, 1, 2)$ is True, then $\neg x(2, 0, 1)$ must be True.
    -   If $x(2, 1, 2)$ is False, then $x(2, 0, 1)$ must be True.

    -   Clauses: $(A \lor \neg B)$ and $(\neg A \lor B)$. This is equivalent to $(A \leftrightarrow \neg B)$, or $A \neq B$. So $x(2, 1, 2) \neq x(2, 0, 1)$.
